questions.question: Technical: At Bank of America, you built Azure Data Factory and Spark SQL ingestion pipelines and administered Databricks workloads. Walk us through a complex Spark SQL transformation over a large dataset that you optimized: how did you structure the data, diagnose bottlenecks, and validate both performance and correctness?

Technical: You reported fixing SCD Type 2 date-chaining defects and duplicate records at Deloitte. How did you identify the root cause, redesign the load logic, and test that historical records and effective-date ranges were correct?

Technical: Describe the architecture of the enterprise AWS data lake you set up at Deloitte, including the roles of S3, EMR, Redshift or RDS, and orchestration. How did the design support analytics, reporting, security, and operational monitoring?

Role-Specific: This role requires ownership of key components of a large-scale data platform and its reporting integration architecture. Given a new source system and several downstream reporting consumers, how would you take the work from requirements discovery through high-level design, implementation, deployment, and support?

Situational: A production pipeline begins producing materially lower record counts after a new source-system release, while business users need reports the next morning. How would you investigate the issue, decide whether to halt or publish data, communicate status, and prevent a recurrence?

Behavioural: Tell us about a time you worked with business partners, business analysts, or a product owner to turn unclear reporting or data requirements into an implementable technical solution. What trade-offs did you explain, and what was the outcome?

Behavioural: At Cumming LLC, you improved FTP file-transfer execution time by 60% by splitting large files into smaller batches. How did you establish the bottleneck, evaluate the risks of the change, and demonstrate that the improvement did not compromise data completeness or reliability?

Role-Specific: The position provides technical direction and mentoring to a small data-engineering team. What experience do you have coordinating technical work or supporting other engineers, and how would you set engineering standards for code reviews, testing, documentation, and reliable pipeline delivery?

Cultural/Motivational: Your background spans Hadoop, Azure, and AWS data engineering, with experience in dashboards using Power BI, SSRS, and Tableau. What motivates you to move into a Staff Data Engineer role that contributes to data strategy as well as hands-on platform delivery, and how would you balance those responsibilities?

Technical: The role expects Scrum delivery and strong SDLC and integration-testing practices. Drawing on your CI/CD, Git, Jenkins, Airflow, and ARM template experience, describe the release process you would establish for a data pipeline change that modifies both transformation logic and a downstream data warehouse schema.
